findings.title: Retained Core/parent image chain accepts unauthorized initial owner/DACL policy
findings.impact: observeOwnedImageAnchor only requires a valid owner SID and a nonempty DACL, then freezes its SDDL. It never checks the owner against an authorized ownership policy or rejects untrusted write/control ACEs. Actual copied Core and parent processes with Everyone FULL_ACCESS on either image ancestor or final image pass ObserveOwnedCoreReadOnly, OpenOwnedCoreRetained and verifyRetained. This fails the explicit strict owner/DACL boundary in CP516 F03 and CP517. Recording an unsafe initial descriptor and comparing it later does not authorize it.
findings.evidence_level: Fresh native Windows own copied executable parent+child, package-private test overlay; two unsafe ACL cases accepted; no production Source edits; no native stop signal
findings.authorized_owner_boundary: Source confirms any valid owner is accepted. No foreign-owner or foreign-user runtime test performed. Explicit policy must distinguish authorized operator and justified OS/install owners.
findings.ace_boundary: Direct final-image Everyone FULL_ACCESS and OICI ancestor Everyone FULL_ACCESS dynamically accepted. First non-inheritable ancestor setup denied child launch and is retained as a harness diagnostic.
findings.share_boundary: Ancestor FILE_SHARE_WRITE allows independently opening a GENERIC_WRITE directory handle during retention. Final-image write sharing and ancestor rename refusal passed fresh tests. No successful namespace replacement or hostile race observed. Directory write sharing alone is not asserted to be an exploit; require deny-write guarantee or a demonstrated equivalent native protection argument.
findings.minimal_fix: Enforce explicit trusted-owner/ACE policy on every Core/parent image component at acquisition and action boundaries; interpret inherited/inherit-only ACEs correctly; reject untrusted modify/write/delete/control rights without broad ACL relaxation. Preserve retained same-handle hash/ID, nonreparse/hardlink checks and reverse closure. Deny ancestor write where required or demonstrate an equally strong native primitive against relevant path mutation.
required_tests: Actual copied parent+child safe ACL positive and direct/inherited Everyone/Users write/control ACE rejection before signal.
Authorized-owner policy positive/negative cuts with honest foreign-user limitation.
Native writable-directory handle/reparse/rename, final-image write-sharing, hardlink and wrong-parent cuts; no unexecuted hostile race claim.
